Name: Artisan Valley Mill Goods
Author: wyndwren
Description:
Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7575]Satozaki's Miller Time framework[/url] to add a few recipes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]PPJA Artisan Valley[/url]'s grinder machine to the mill building.

[list]
[*]1 corn can be milled﻿ into 1 corn flour.
[*]1 buckwheat can be milled into 1 buckwheat flour.
[*]1 sugar cane can be milled into 5 sugar.
[*]1 sugar beet can be milled into 3 sugar.
[/list]
Requires Miller Time and Artisan Valley.

---

There is a separate version on the Files tab that adds only the sugar beets & sugar cane. Use this version if you want [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]PPJA Fruits & Veggies[/url] but [i]not [/i]Artisan Valley.

---﻿

To install, unzip into your mods folder.
